title: piptatheropsis pungens
intro: Piptatheropsis pungens, commonly known as Western yarrow, is a flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating wounds, reducing fever, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Western yarrow include stimulating circulation, reducing pain and inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Western yarrow include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, such as borneol and camphor, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
